description: Existential quantification increases the monadic quantifier count by one: \(q(\exists x\,\varphi)=q(\varphi)+1\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.quantifiers_ex {k n : ℕ}
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).BoundedFormula Empty (n + 1)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.quantifiers φ.ex =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.quantifiers φ + 1
